script.text: I used to kill every basil I brought home. This little terracotta pot sits in a water reservoir, so it drinks on its own, and a tiny window shows me when to refill—like every two weeks. Honestly, get one.

note: Run in two stages from the box with nanoodle-js: the stills, script and voice first ($0.054293 by balance delta), then LongCat Avatar 1.5 from the saved selfie frame and voice ($0.56), same prompts and settings as this graph. MiniMax Speech reported no cost; its $0.0204 (204 characters at $0.10 per 1,000) is the stage-one balance delta minus the reported node costs. LongCat billed 14 s at $0.04/s for the 13.1 s voice. The stills were re-encoded to smaller WebP files for the gallery. A $0.001 Whisper check of the ad's audio matched the script word for word.
